title: Here’s what happened in crypto today
summary: Need to know what happened in crypto today? Here is the latest news on daily trends and events impacting Bitcoin price, blockchain, DeFi, NFTs, Web3 and crypto regulation.

title: Russia introduces bill to criminalize unregistered crypto services
summary: Individuals and groups would be required to register with the Bank of Russia before offering certain crypto services, or potentially face fines and prison time.

title: Polymarket odds of Hormuz Strait traffic normalizing by end of May spike to 73%
summary: Traders on the Polymarket prediction market platform place the odds of the Strait returning to normal traffic by May 31, 2026, at 73%.

title: US Senator asks for Binance monitor update amid scrutiny of Iran sanctions
summary: A letter from US Senator Richard Blumenthal said he was concerned about “mounting allegations of dangerously lax anti-money laundering prevention by Binance.”

title: Ether accumulation wallet balances increased by 33%: Is a rally to $3K next?
summary: A confirmed cup-and-handle breakout on Ether’s chart and a double-digit increase in ETH accumulation wallet balances could be earlier signs of a longer-term rally for the altcoin.

title: Crypto market liquidations hit $820M as Bitcoin price taps $78K
summary: Nearly a billion dollars in leveraged crypto positions were liquidated in the past 24 hours as the Bitcoin price rallied above $78,000.

title: Kraken's parent company to acquire CFTC-regulated exchange Bitnomial
summary: Payward, the parent company of the Kraken crypto exchange, cited Bitnomial's regulatory licenses as the primary driver for the acquisition.

title: Price predictions 4/17: BTC, ETH, XRP, BNB, SOL, DOGE, HYPE, ADA, BCH, LINK
summary: Bitcoin pole vaulted to $78,000 and altcoins soared after Iran said that the Strait of Hormuz was fully open. Will bulls be able to sustain the upward momentum?

title: Singapore Gulf Bank adds stablecoin mint and redeem for 24/7 settlement
summary: The Bahrain-based lender lets institutional clients convert fiat currency to US dollar-pegged stablecoins directly from their accounts.

title: French finance minister backs euro-pegged stablecoins to compete with US
summary: The country's finance minister supported the Qivalis initiative, launched in 2025, to create a euro-pegged stablecoin under the MiCA framework.
